text: Yes, the trigger needs a volume test. minervini and oneil are right on my own method: a break on light volume is a potential upthrust until it proves itself (C5), and a sign-of-strength bar needs relatively high volume (C12). GRDN printed day_vol 0.66 at D close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.51: not yet a break I trust. I accept 1.4x normal (stricter than my 1.2x). Dissent cannot stay []: list minervini, oneil and me. I still prefer the test of structure_shift_ref after the break (C7). Wrong if a daily close back under structure_shift_ref.
